Name: Sable's JojaProducts SVBO Patch
Author: Sable17
Description:
[quote][color=#ffffff][size=5]Rebalancing my [/size][/color][color=#6d9eeb][size=5]Joja [/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=5]shenanigans[/size][/color][color=#6d9eeb][size=5]![/size][/color][/quote]
My attempt at rebalancing my Joja mods for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul[/url]! Rather than keep a patch on each page, here's an AIO!

Use any combination of my Joja mods; this patch does [b]NOT [/b]require all of them to be present.

The prices are balanced around SVBO's recommended Profit Margin of 100%. (Most of this involved increasing prices overall.)

Let me know of any spots that still feel off! 

[b]Supports (But does not require all of them!)[/b]
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBite TV Dinners[/url] -  Prices adjusted, limited stock of breakfast TV dinner, Ice Cream, JojaMilk, and JojaEggs.
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry Canned Goods[/url] -  Prices adjusted. Also adjusted the Canned Meats addon!
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38012]JojaFizzy Energy Drinks[/url] - Prices adjusted.
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38341]JojaFresh Healthy Snacks[/url] - Prices adjusted.
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42212]JojaMart Sells It Too[/url] - Prices adjusted, limited stock of saplings, fertilizer, and items on the condiments aisle.
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39109]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/url] - Prices adjusted, limited stock of both fertilizers.
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49692]Joja Attends Festivals[/url] - Limited stock of Strawberry seeds at the Egg Festival.
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42874]Bird Feeders[/url] - Limited stock of bird feeds from Marnie and JojaMart.
   •  (JojaMills didn't feel like it needed price increases. If folks disagree, let me know!)

[b]Requirements
[/b]   •  Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul
   •  Stardew Valley 1.6+
   •  SMAPI
   •  Content Patcher
